author: Aaronjacobs000
summary: These parsers read firewall logs from Arista VeloCloud SD-WAN Edges. The Edges send them as syslog straight to the data collector. Session lines go to Netflow and IDS/IPS alerts go to NIDS.
notes:
Setup:
- Arista VeloCloud SD-WAN (formerly VMware SD-WAN) Edges send firewall logs straight to the data collector.
- In the Orchestrator, add a syslog collector under Device > Telemetry > Syslog with the FIREWALL EVENT role (UDP or TCP, port 514 by default), and turn on Syslog Forwarding on the Firewall page, for the Profile or the Edge.
- The Edge reaches the collector over the Cloud VPN or a LAN, so the collector has to be on a network the Edge can route to.

Field mapping:
- Session lines go to Netflow: VCF Open, Close, Update and Deny with the stateful firewall on, Allow and Deny with it off, and Drop.
- Each session line has the addresses, ports and protocol, FW_ALLOWED or FW_BLOCKED, and source NAT; Close lines add the application, bytes and the close reason.
- The session ID, segment, firewall policy, interface, destination name, VLANs and duration go to event_metadata.
- Enhanced Firewall Services IDS/IPS alerts (VCF Alert) go to NIDS with the signature name, ID, category and severity.
- blocked is set when ATP_ACTION starts with Drop, Block, Deny, Reject or Reset; Arista doesn't list its values.
- The parser accepts any syslog tag.

Time:
- The syslog time has no year or zone and is read as UTC.

Sources and licenses:
- Arista's syslog table doesn't list the alert keys or the Drop action, so those follow the syslog queries in the Microsoft Sentinel VMware SD-WAN and SASE solution.

Made up in the samples:
- Samples are made up in the layout of Arista's firewall log example and field table.

Testing:
- Each child, combined with the parent into one parser, passed Run Test in a lab tenant on 2026-10-15 (104 of 104 fields matched the emulator), and the parent's confirm string picked the same lines there.
- Each child also passed Run Test as a separate parser under its parent (9 of 9 lines, 104 of 104 fields).
- No built-in parser claimed these lines in 12 Run Tests.

Known gaps:
- Edge events (the EDGE EVENT role) have no published layout and stay unparsed.
